C1822.title: Shanghai Qingpu: Express Delivery Contractor Used Custom Software to Falsify Weights on 100,000+ Parcels, Defrauding Nearly 2.5 Million Yuan in Freight
C1822.summary: From January 2021, Ye and Hu, second-tier contractors of an express delivery company, sought profit by contacting Jun and He (via Gao) to custom-build software that modified parcel weight data, attaching it to the station's electronic scales. Each parcel generated two records: actual data (charged to customers) and falsified data (uploaded to the company backend); parcels over 3 kg were reduced to under 3 kg via the software so they paid less freight and pocketed the difference. In just over a year they falsified 100,000+ parcels, with Ye illegally gaining 2 million+ yuan and Hu 370,000+ yuan. In April 2023, the Qingpu District Procuratorate of Shanghai prosecuted all five for fraud.
